posts.caption:
There is something so beautiful about watching young people be given the space to fully be themselves and embraced in the ever-expanding possibilities of what it means to be human. 🌈✨

Every child deserves the opportunity to explore their creativity, imagination, joy, and unique potential without shame or limitation. We are so grateful to be part of creating the kinds of spaces we wish existed growing up, and we can’t wait to see where this path leads. 

Thank you @bridgeschoolcooperative for hosting us and to @whitecenterpride for sponsorship the event!

Also big shout out to our photographer and videographer @jesse_sieden for capturing the magic!

#seattle #seattleevents #dragstorytime #dragchurch

posts.caption:
Our Movement for Mindfulness class has been curious the last two weeks! They read "The Sea In The Way" by Sophie Gilmore. This prompted them to take a walk to look for beautiful and unusual objects. Then they concluded the day with an outdoor mud kitchen. 

This week they read "Niko Draws a Feeling" by Bob Raczka while they turned chalk into chalk paint and beautiful art. During the afternoon they played a cooperative water passing game. 

There's still time to enroll for next year and take a tour! Reach out to our head of school, amanda@bridgeschoolcoop.org to start the process. 🌈
